raw_proposal.rationale: The focal passage establishes that discounts above 15% require Finance (Head of Finance & People Ops) approval before the deal is closed. This is stated in the policy document POL-01, specifically in the section 'Formal requirements' under the heading 'Discount Approval Policy'. The relevant text is: '1. Any discount of **15% or greater** off list price on a new-business deal requires written approval from the Head of Finance & People Ops before the deal is marked Closed Won in the CRM.'
